answer.summary: AttackPathApiRbacTest and AttackPathApiTest fail because the Spring ApplicationContext cannot start: a bean dependency cycle (workflowService -> workflowEndService -> notificationEventService -> scenarioNotificationEventHandler -> exerciseService -> workflowService). The change touches WorkflowEndService and NotificationEventService, which sit in that cycle, so a rerun will fail the same way. The flake history (persisted 2x before, never flaked) also points to a deterministic failure. Caveat: the log does not show whether the cycle exists on the base branch, so the link to this change is inferred from the touched files.

evidence.quote: Relying upon circular references is discouraged and they are prohibited by default.
